subject: Preventing automatic log deletion in Shiny Server

messages.author: 65b36fc7ed4b5fa2
messages.subject: Preventing automatic log deletion in Shiny Server
parts:
The Shiny Server documentation specifies that:
"Log files will be created for each R process when it is started. However, if a process closes successfully, the error log associated with that process will be automatically deleted. "

Is there any way to prevent this default behavior? I would like for my log files to persist between sessions, even on error-free exits.

Thanks!

messages.author: bbc57ffa8a14ad13
messages.subject: Re: Preventing automatic log deletion in Shiny Server
parts:
Hi Winn,

Sadly there's not at the moment, but we're currently working on a new logging infrastructure that will provide more flexibility and control in this area, so hopefully this will be possible in the near future!

Jeff

messages.author: 65b36fc7ed4b5fa2
messages.subject: Re: Preventing automatic log deletion in Shiny Server
parts:
Thanks, Jeff. 

I found a workaround, which was to just append the desired output to a separate log file in /var/log/shiny-server

-Winn

messages.subject: Re: Preventing automatic log deletion in Shiny Server
parts:
Not sure if you have made any progress on this, but we are really interested in a new logging infrastructure to integrate with Logstash. Currently we output everything to another file, then pull out all errors to send an email of them. 

We can't wait for a new logging infrastructure.

Thank you,
Evan Farrell
